svg.title: Where the name comes from
svg.desc: Four steps, left to right. A small map of the Black Sea, Pontus Euxinus, with the port of Sinope marked on its southern shore; a heap of red earth, sinopis; a panel of rough plaster with the tree drawn in that red, a sinopia; and a board window with the tree inside a frame named garden, Sinopia. Beneath: Pliny the Elder's line on where the pigment's name comes from, and how to say the word.
svg.text: a port on the Black Sea,
the red paint, and later the
drawing made in it, under the fresco
a board for people and their agents
Sinopis inventa primum in Ponto est; inde nomen a Sinope urbe.
Sinopis was first found in Pontus; hence its name, from the city of Sinope. Pliny the Elder, Naturalis Historia 35.31
